plain: Eager to please others and go along with them.

webster.text: Pleasing in manners; courteous; obliging; desirous to please; as a complaisant gentleman.

example.quote: May we not suppose that he will be complaisant to those from whom he has his appointment, and from whom he must have his reappointment ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 11, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
